items.reason: misc/theme-verifier/pom.xml:32-33 targets Java 17, where PropertyResourceBundle(InputStream) defaults to UTF-8 and falls back to ISO-8859-1 only for invalid UTF-8. Therefore the constructors in misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:68 and :77 correctly decode valid UTF-8 translations; the claimed ISO-8859-1 default and resulting mojibake are false.
